nodes.label: Lumin Sign, Inc.
nodes.excerpt: Lumin Sign, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Provider”), and Acme Holdings LLC … are each a “Party.”
nodes.summary: Provider under the MSA; a disclosing/receiving party on the mutual NDA.

nodes.label: Acme Holdings LLC
nodes.excerpt: Acme Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“Customer”).
nodes.summary: Customer under the MSA; counterpart on the mutual NDA.

nodes.label: Affiliates
nodes.excerpt: Affiliates of a Party are included where this Agreement so states. Affiliates are bound to the same extent…
nodes.summary: Defined group that inherits party duties on both instruments.

nodes.label: Master Services Agreement
nodes.excerpt: This Master Services Agreement (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of the Effective Date…
nodes.summary: Primary commercial instrument: services, IP, indemnity, liability, term.

nodes.label: Mutual NDA
nodes.excerpt: This Mutual Nondisclosure Agreement (this “NDA”) is entered into as of the Effective Date…
nodes.summary: Pre-signature diligence NDA; broader CI definition; incorporated by MSA §6.3.

nodes.label: Confidential Information
nodes.excerpt: “Confidential Information” means non-public information disclosed by a Party … marked confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential…
nodes.summary: Defined in MSA §1 and more broadly in NDA §2. God node — many clauses hang off it.

nodes.label: Services
nodes.excerpt: “Services” means Provider’s hosted electronic-signature and contract-workspace software, plus professional services…
nodes.summary: What Lumin must perform; specified further in Exhibit A.

nodes.label: Customer Data
nodes.excerpt: “Customer Data” means data, files, and content submitted by or on behalf of Customer to the Services…
nodes.summary: Owned by Acme; governed by Exhibit E; fuels Customer’s indemnity.

nodes.label: Custom Deliverables
nodes.excerpt: “Custom Deliverables” means configuration, templates, and workflow artifacts created uniquely for Customer…
nodes.summary: Assigned to Customer on payment under MSA §5.2.

nodes.label: Indemnified Claim
nodes.excerpt: “Indemnified Claim” means a third-party claim described in Section 8.
nodes.summary: Bridge term between §8 indemnity and §9 liability carve-outs.

nodes.label: MSA §1 Definitions
nodes.excerpt: Confidential Information, Customer Data, Custom Deliverables, Services, and Indemnified Claim are defined here.
nodes.summary: Canonical glossary for the MSA.

nodes.label: MSA §2 Services & Fees
nodes.excerpt: Provider shall perform the Services … Customer shall pay the Fees set out in Exhibit A within thirty (30) days.
nodes.summary: Performance and payment pair.

nodes.label: MSA §5 IP Ownership
nodes.excerpt: Customer owns Customer Data and Custom Deliverables. Provider hereby assigns … Custom Deliverables upon full payment.
nodes.summary: Split ownership: platform stays with Lumin; Custom Deliverables assign to Acme.

nodes.label: MSA §6 Confidentiality
nodes.excerpt: The duties in this Section 6 survive for five (5) years … Where the NDA’s definition … is broader, the NDA controls for those pre-signature materials.
nodes.summary: Five-year survival; defers to the NDA for diligence materials.

nodes.label: MSA §8 Indemnification
nodes.excerpt: Provider shall defend and indemnify Customer against Indemnified Claims alleging that the unmodified Services infringe… Customer shall … indemnify Provider against … Customer Data…
nodes.summary: Bilateral indemnity: Lumin for IP; Acme for Customer Data.

nodes.label: MSA §9 Limitation of Liability
nodes.excerpt: Except for … indemnification obligations under Section 8.1 … breach of Section 6 … aggregate liability … will not exceed the Fees paid or payable … in the twelve (12) months before the first claim.
nodes.summary: 12-month fees cap with express carve-outs for IP indemnity and confidentiality.

nodes.label: MSA §10 Term & Termination
nodes.excerpt: The Initial Term is twelve (12) months … Upon termination, Recipient shall return or securely destroy Discloser’s Confidential Information within thirty (30) days.
nodes.summary: Initial term, renewal, convenience, breach — and a CI return trigger.

nodes.label: MSA §10.2 Notice
nodes.excerpt: After the Initial Term, either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the other Party at least ninety (90) days’ prior written notice.
nodes.summary: 90-day written notice for convenience after the Initial Term.

nodes.label: NDA §2 CI Definition
nodes.excerpt: “Confidential Information” means all non-public information, whether marked or unmarked, and whether disclosed in writing, orally, visually, or by inspection…
nodes.summary: Broader CI definition: oral + unmarked + 10-day write-up.

nodes.label: NDA §4 Term
nodes.excerpt: This NDA begins on the Effective Date and continues for three (3) years, except that obligations as to trade secrets continue…
nodes.summary: Three-year NDA term; trade secrets last longer.

nodes.label: NDA §5 Return / Destroy
nodes.excerpt: Upon the disclosing Party’s written request, or automatically upon termination … Recipient shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information…
nodes.summary: Return/destroy with 15-day certification.

nodes.label: Perform the Services
nodes.excerpt: Provider shall perform the Services in material accordance with this Agreement and each Statement of Work…
nodes.summary: Lumin’s primary performance obligation.

nodes.label: Pay Fees (30 days)
nodes.excerpt: Customer shall pay the Fees set out in Exhibit A within thirty (30) days of invoice.
nodes.summary: Acme’s payment obligation.

nodes.label: Protect Confidential Information
nodes.excerpt: Each Party shall use the other Party’s Confidential Information only to perform this Agreement and shall not disclose it…
nodes.summary: Bilateral CI duty on MSA and NDA.

nodes.label: IP indemnity (Provider)
nodes.excerpt: Provider shall defend and indemnify Customer against Indemnified Claims alleging that the unmodified Services infringe…
nodes.summary: Carved out of the §9 cap.

nodes.label: Customer Data indemnity
nodes.excerpt: Customer shall defend and indemnify Provider against Indemnified Claims arising from Customer Data…
nodes.summary: Acme’s indemnity for uploaded content and instructions.

nodes.label: 90-day termination notice
nodes.excerpt: …terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the other Party at least ninety (90) days’ prior written notice.
nodes.summary: Either party; typically hunted as Customer exit mechanics.

nodes.label: Return or destroy CI
nodes.excerpt: Recipient shall return or securely destroy Discloser’s Confidential Information within thirty (30) days…
nodes.summary: Triggered by MSA termination and by NDA §5.

nodes.label: Maintain Exhibit B insurance
nodes.excerpt: Provider shall maintain the coverages described in Exhibit B … cyber/E&O … not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence.
nodes.summary: Lumin’s insurance covenant.

nodes.label: Exhibit A — SOW
nodes.excerpt: This Agreement incorporates Exhibit A (Statement of Work)… Fees set out in Exhibit A.
nodes.summary: Scope, Fees, and professional-services description.

nodes.label: Exhibit B — Insurance
nodes.excerpt: Provider shall maintain the coverages described in Exhibit B for the Term…
nodes.summary: Insurance schedule referenced by §11.

nodes.label: Exhibit E — DPA
nodes.excerpt: Provider may use subprocessors listed in Exhibit E. Provider shall give Customer thirty (30) days’ notice before adding a subprocessor…
nodes.summary: Processes Customer Data; names subprocessors (AWS and successors).

edges.why: The MSA cover and signature block name Lumin Sign, Inc. as Provider — an explicit party listing, not an inference.
Acme Holdings LLC is named Customer on the same cover and signature block.
The NDA preamble lists Lumin Sign, Inc. as a disclosing/receiving Party.
The NDA preamble lists Acme Holdings LLC as the counterpart Party.
The same two legal entities appear as the only named counterparties on both the MSA and the NDA, so the graph treats them as a bilateral pair.
Both instruments say Affiliates of a Party are included or bound. The edge is inferred because the text does not list Lumin’s subsidiaries by name.
Same Affiliate language binds Acme’s group. Inferred — no schedule of Acme affiliates is attached.
MSA §6.3 expressly keeps the 12 September 2026 NDA in force for pre-signature diligence and defers to the NDA’s broader CI definition.
Section 1 prints the quoted definition of “Confidential Information” used for the commercial term.
NDA §2 restates Confidential Information more broadly (oral, unmarked, facility inspection) and says that broader read controls for diligence.
Section 1 defines Services as the hosted e-sign workspace plus SOW professional services.
Section 1 defines Customer Data as files and signer attributes submitted to the Services.
Section 1 defines Custom Deliverables and excludes Provider’s pre-existing platform.
“Indemnified Claim” is defined as a third-party claim described in Section 8 — the term only has meaning through that article.
§2.1 uses shall: “Provider shall perform the Services in material accordance with this Agreement and each Statement of Work.”
§2.2 uses shall: “Customer shall pay the Fees set out in Exhibit A within thirty (30) days of invoice.”
§6.1 binds each Party. Lumin is a Party, so it owes the same protect-and-use-only duty.
The same “each Party shall” sentence binds Acme — confidentiality is not one-sided.
§8.1: Provider shall defend and indemnify Customer for unmodified-Services IP claims.
§8.2: Customer shall defend and indemnify Provider for claims arising from Customer Data or instructions.
§10.2 requires the terminating Party to give 90 days’ written notice. Acme owes that duty if it exits for convenience.
The same notice sentence is bilateral — “either Party may terminate … by giving the other Party at least ninety (90) days’ prior written notice.”
MSA §10.4 and NDA §5 put the return/destroy duty on the Recipient. Lumin is a Recipient of Acme CI.
Acme is likewise a Recipient of Lumin CI, so the same return/destroy covenant applies on exit.
§11: “Provider shall maintain the coverages described in Exhibit B for the Term.”
The performance obligation is the operative sentence of §2.1, not a later interpretation.
Payment is the operative sentence of §2.2 in the same article as performance.
The protect-and-limited-use duty is the body of MSA §6.1, with five-year survival in §6.2.
The obligation’s object is the defined term Confidential Information — without the definition the duty has no scope.
Provider’s IP indemnity is §8.1’s shall-defend sentence.
Customer’s data indemnity is §8.2 in the same article — a paired, not one-way, indemnity.
The 90-day notice obligation is the entire text of the §10.2 Notice subclause.
§10.1’s renewal rule points at “notice under Section 10.2,” so termination-for-convenience is incomplete without that subclause.
§10.4 opens with “Upon termination,” then commands return or secure destruction of Confidential Information within 30 days.
NDA §5 independently requires return/destroy (and a 15-day certificate) when talks or a later services agreement end.
§11 does not list limits itself — it incorporates Exhibit B as the coverage schedule, including $2M cyber/E&O.
§9.1’s cap sentence names “indemnification obligations under Section 8.1” as an exception. The articles are neighbors because the cap is meaningless until you know which indemnity is carved out.
The cap applies “except for a Party’s indemnification obligations under Section 8.1 (intellectual-property indemnity)” — IP indemnity sits outside the 12-month fees ceiling.
The same except-clause names “breach of Section 6 (Confidentiality),” so CI breaches are not swallowed by the cap.
The 12-month Fees cap is mutual (“neither Party’s aggregate liability”) and therefore limits Lumin on ordinary contract claims.
The same mutual cap limits Acme — including, unless a carve-out applies, its Customer Data indemnity exposure.
The exhibits clause lists Exhibit A (Statement of Work) as incorporated into the Agreement.
The same sentence incorporates Exhibit B (Insurance).
Exhibit E (Data Processing Addendum) is incorporated and is the home of the subprocessor list.
§2.1 says Services are performed “in material accordance with … each Statement of Work attached as Exhibit A.”
§2.3 routes Customer Data processing and subprocessor notice through Exhibit E.
§8.2’s indemnity is for claims “arising from Customer Data.” The defined term is the factual predicate of Acme’s indemnity, even though the sentence does not say “fuels.”
§6 repeatedly uses the Section 1 defined term rather than restating a new definition.
NDA §5’s return/destroy object is Confidential Information as defined in NDA §2.
§4’s three-year clock and trade-secret tail are duration rules for the CI duty; the section never repeats the words “Confidential Information,” so the link is inferred from context.
§5.2 assigns Custom Deliverables to Customer upon full payment of the applicable Fees.
§5.2 also states that, as between the Parties, Customer owns Customer Data.
§2.1’s performance sentence is written in terms of the defined Services.
Section 1 is a numbered article of the MSA source file.
Section 9 is a numbered article of the MSA source file.
Section 10 is a numbered article of the MSA source file.
Section 2 is a numbered article of the NDA source file.
